TI Spatial transcriptomics reveals tumor microenvironment heterogeneity in colorectal cancer
SO NATURE MEDICINE
AB Spatial transcriptomics enables the mapping of gene expression within intact tissue sections. We applied spatial transcriptomics to 45 colorectal cancer specimens and identified distinct tumor microenvironment niches associated with patient outcomes.

TI Machine learning approaches for biomarker discovery in spatially resolved transcriptomic data
SO BIOINFORMATICS
